Energy maintains a firm grip on leadership, with Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.866), Oil & Gas Drilling (0.838), and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.833) anchoring the top momentum tier. Breadth remains selective, with only 20 of 144 groups exhibiting all-green performance across all timeframes. Transport and commercial services are rotating aggressively higher, headlined by Rental & Leasing Services climbing 26 spots to rank 33 alongside strong 5-day gains in Integrated Freight & Logistics (+18 spots).

Conversely, severe drawdowns are hitting cyclical manufacturing and select defensive pockets. Textile Manufacturing experienced an outright collapse, plunging 119 spots to rank 141 with a weak 0.21 momentum score. Meanwhile, earlier leadership in segments like Healthcare Plans and Reinsurance is beginning to stall, showing early divergence as short-term rank slips despite nominally high momentum readings.

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Early fatigue is appearing in Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.65, -8 spots in 5d), Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.69, -7 spots in 5d), Lodging (momentum 0.67, -7 spots in 5d), and Medical Distribution (momentum 0.68, -6 spots in 5d).
